text: Sessions API spins up isolated browser instances on demand, each with its own state, cookies, and storage
quote: the Sessions API lets your agents spin up isolated browser instances on demand. Each session maintains its own state, cookies, and storage

text: Single flag enables captcha detection, solving, and verification for an entire session
quote: One flag covers detection, solving, and verification for the whole session

text: Supports built-in managed residential proxies or bring-your-own-proxy for stealth automation
quote: Steel offers two powerful ways to use proxies: our built-in **Managed Residential Proxies** or connecting to your own proxy provider with our **Bring Your Own Proxy (BYOP)** feature.

text: Maintains authenticated browser state across sessions so agents skip repeated logins
quote: This is particularly useful for maintaining authenticated states across multiple sessions, helping your AI agents access protected resources efficiently without repeatedly handling login processes

text: Debug URL lets a human view and directly control a running browser session
quote: Steel's debug URL feature allows you to implement human-in-the-loop workflows where users can directly interact with and control browser sessions.

text: Converts a session recording into a step-by-step timeline of agent activity for easier debugging
quote: It turns the run into a timeline of agent activity, so you can see what happened without scrubbing through the whole recording.

text: Run data can be exported as markdown, JSON, or a ZIP bundle with markdown and screenshots
quote: Copy the run as markdown, download JSON, or grab a ZIP with markdown plus screenshots.

text: Official CLI lets you run a full browser workflow (start session, navigate, interact, extract, stop) from the terminal
quote: The Steel CLI lets you run full browser workflows from the terminal, end-to-end. You can start a browser session, navigate pages, click/fill/type, extract content, and stop the session

text: Exposes the cloud browser as MCP tools so agents can connect and drive it via an official MCP server
quote: The Steel integration exposes a cloud browser as in-process MCP tools, so the SDK runs the agent loop and Steel handles the browser.

text: Session IDs can be auto-generated or supplied as a custom UUID before the browser session exists
quote: Steel generates a session ID for you, but `create` also accepts one. Pass your own UUID when the ID has to exist before the browser does

text: Full CDP control lets existing Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium automation code connect to Steel's browsers
quote: Uses Puppeteer and CDP for complete control over Chrome instances -- allowing you to connect using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium.

text: Supports loading custom Chrome extensions into browser sessions
quote: Extension Support: Load custom Chrome extensions for enhanced functionality

text: Provides browser tool APIs to convert pages to markdown, readability text, screenshots, or PDFs
quote: Browser Tools: Exposes APIs to quick convert pages to markdown, readability, screenshots, or PDFs.

text: Ships a pre-built Docker image combining API and UI for self-hosting
